newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers resolved to reach EMU budget accord.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers resolved to reach EMU budget accord.

text.p: European Union finance ministers are determined to reach a final accord on a budget stability pact by December for countries joining a single currency, diplomats said on Monday.
"We've got a lot of pressure to agree on this," said one diplomat familiar with talks on the pact among ministers meeting here.

Yet several differences over details remained, particularly on a precise definition of so-called exceptional and temporary economic circumstances which would alllow a government with an excessive deficit to avoid sanctions.
Diplomats said a compromise appeared to be emerging that would allow quantification of an economic recession but still give EU finance ministers discretion in evaluating a country's performance.

German Economic State Secretary Juergen Stark said Germany had stuck to its original proposal for strong sanctions against countries that fail to keep their budgets in line and numerical definitions of the exceptional cases that would allow countries to avoid those sanctions.
Stark said the content of the hoped-for consensus was more important than reaching an accord by a specific deadline.
